units.title: 财来就我终须易，我去寻财必是难

rule.yi: 财爻生、合、克世爻或持世，为「财来就我」，容易得；财爻虽动而与世爻无关，为「我去寻财」，难得。野鹤：不可拘泥，兄弟持世、财不生合世爻而照样得财的卦也有。
rule.en: The Wealth line generating, combining with, controlling or sitting on the Self line is 'the money coming to me': easy to get. A moving Wealth line with no tie to the Self line is 'me going after the money': hard. Yehe: do not cling to this; there are hexagrams with Peer on the Self line and no Wealth reaching it where the money came all the same.

zh: 财来就我，终须易；
我去寻财，必是难。
yi: 财来找我，终究容易；
我去找财，一定困难。
en: When the money comes to me, it is easy in the end;
when I go looking for the money, it is sure to be hard.

zh: 凡遇财爻生合世爻，克世持世，皆谓财来就我，必然易得。
若虽动出财爻，而与世爻不相干者，谓我去寻财，必难望也。
yi: 凡是财爻生合世爻，或克世、持世，都叫财来就我，一定容易得。
如果虽然动出了财爻，却和世爻没有关系，叫作我去找财，一定难有指望。
en: Whenever the Wealth line generates or combines with the Self line, controls it or sits on it, that is called the money coming to me, and it is easy to get.
If a Wealth line moves but has nothing to do with the Self line, that is called me going after the money, and there is little hope.

zh: 财爻生合世爻，持世克世，皆谓财来就我，必然易得；
若财爻而与世爻不相干者，谓我去寻财，必难望也。
yi: 财爻生合世爻，或持世、克世，都叫财来就我，一定容易得；
如果财爻和世爻不相干，叫作我去找财，一定难有指望。
en: The Wealth line generating or combining with the Self line, sitting on it or controlling it, is called the money coming to me: easy to get;
if the Wealth line has nothing to do with the Self line, that is me going after the money, with little hope.

zh: 财来就我终须易，我去求财定是难。
旧注，凡遇财爻生世、合世、克世、持世，皆谓之财来就我。
若卦中虽有财动，不来生合世爻，亦非我之财也。
yi: 财来就我终究容易，我去求财一定困难。
旧注说：凡是财爻生世、合世、克世、持世，都叫财来就我。
卦中即使有财爻发动，不来生合世爻，也不是我的财。
en: When the money comes to me it is easy in the end; when I go seeking it, it is sure to be hard.
The old commentary: whenever the Wealth line generates, combines with, controls or sits on the Self line, it is called the money coming to me.
Even if Wealth moves in the hexagram, if it does not generate or combine with the Self line, the money is not mine.

zh: 野鹤曰：亦不可拘执此说。
总之，善断者贵乎通变，以参其理，久之自能触类而悟，
即如前二卦，兄弟持世，何尝财来生合耶？
yi: 野鹤说：这个说法也不能死守。
总之，会断卦的人贵在变通，去琢磨其中的道理，久了自然能触类旁通，
就像前面两卦，兄弟持世，哪里有财来生合世爻呢？（两卦都照样得了财）
en: Yehe says: this rule must not be held rigidly either.
In short, a good reader values flexibility and weighs the reasoning; in time one learns to see the analogies,
as in the two previous cases: Peer sat on the Self line, and when did the money ever come to generate or combine with it? (Yet both got the money.)

units.title: 身遇旺财，似取囊中之物；世持动弟，如捞水底之针

rule.yi: 世爻持财：即使无气也容易得，旺相更好；世爻持兄弟：安静也难得，发动更难。
rule.en: Wealth on the Self line: easy to get even without force, better still if thriving. Peer on the Self line: hard even when still, harder when moving.

zh: 身遇旺财，似取囊中之物；
世持动弟，如捞水底之针。
yi: 世爻临旺相的财，像从自己口袋里拿东西；
世爻上是发动的兄弟，像在水底捞针。
en: If the Self line carries a strong Wealth, it is like taking something out of your own pocket;
if the Self line carries a moving Peer, it is like fishing a needle from the bottom of the water.

zh: 世为求财之人。
若临财爻，虽或无气，亦主易得；旺相更美。
若临兄弟，虽或安静，亦主难得；发动尤甚。
yi: 世爻是求财的人。
世爻如果临财爻，即使无气，也主容易得；旺相更好。
如果临兄弟，即使安静，也主难得；发动就更难。
en: The Self line is the person seeking the money.
If it carries the Wealth line, the money is easy to get even without seasonal force; thriving is better still.
If it carries Peer, the money is hard to get even when the line is still; moving, harder still.

zh: 世为求财之人，若临财爻，虽或无气，必主易得，旺相更美；
若临兄弟，虽或安静，亦主难得，发动尤甚。
yi: 世爻是求财的人，如果临财爻，即使无气，也一定容易得，旺相更好；
如果临兄弟，即使安静，也主难得，发动更甚。
en: The Self line is the person seeking the money; if it carries the Wealth line, the money is surely easy to get even without force, and better still if thriving;
if it carries Peer, it is hard even when still, and harder when moving.

units.title: 福变财生，滚滚财源不竭

rule.yi: 子孙发动（生财），利长久；子孙化财、财化子孙，而且生合世爻、卦身，财源不绝。
rule.en: A moving Output line (which feeds Wealth) means lasting profit; Output turning into Wealth, or Wealth into Output, especially generating or combining with the Self and Body lines, means money that keeps coming.

zh: 福变财生，
滚滚财源不竭；
yi: 子孙动而变出财来，
财源滚滚，用之不竭；
en: When Output turns into Wealth,
the money rolls in and never runs dry;

zh: 占财，得子孙发动，利必久远。
更化财爻，生合身世，乃绵绵不绝之象，尽求则尽有也。
财化子亦妙。
yi: 占财时，子孙发动，利一定长久。
再变出财爻，生合卦身、世爻，是绵绵不绝之象，要多少有多少。
财化子孙也好。
en: In a money question, a moving Output line means a lasting profit.
If it also turns into a Wealth line that generates or combines with the Body and Self lines, the money never stops: whatever you ask for, you get.
Wealth turning into Output is also good.

zh: 占财得子孙发动，利必久远，
更兼财爻生合世身，乃绵绵不绝之象。
遇有财化子亦然。
yi: 占财时子孙发动，利一定长久；
再加上财爻生合世爻、卦身，是绵绵不绝之象。
遇到财化子孙也一样。
en: In a money question a moving Output line means a lasting profit;
if the Wealth line also generates or combines with the Self and Body lines, the money never stops.
Wealth turning into Output is the same.

zh: 福变财生，利源滚滚。
财得子动生之，如财之有源也，其利丰厚。
倘得子动化财、财动化子者，皆同此断。
yi: 子孙变出财，利源滚滚。
财爻得到发动的子孙来生，就像财有了源头，利益丰厚。
如果是子孙动化财、财动化子孙，都这样断。
en: Output turning into Wealth: profit rolls on and on.
When a moving Output line feeds Wealth, the money has a spring, and the profit is rich.
Output moving into Wealth and Wealth moving into Output are judged the same way.

units.title: 兄连鬼克，纷纷口舌难逃

rule.yi: 兄弟、官鬼同时发动（王洪绪），或兄弟动而官鬼克世：主口舌是非，父母再动则成官讼。兄弟动变官鬼是回头克，兄弟被制，不能劫财克世（王洪绪、觉子驳旧注）；但野鹤举例，问财而见兄化鬼，可能应在兄弟（亲人）身上。
rule.en: Peer and Pressure moving together (Wang Hongxu), or Peer moving while Pressure controls the Self line: quarrels and trouble, and a lawsuit if Resource moves too. Peer moving into Pressure is a turn-back control that disables Peer, so it cannot rob or attack the Self line (Wang Hongxu and Juezi against the old commentary); but Yehe gives a case where Peer turning into Pressure in a money question showed up as a brother's death.

zh: 兄连鬼克，
纷纷口舌难逃。
yi: 兄弟连着官鬼来克，
免不了纷纷口舌。
en: When Peer comes together with Pressure to attack,
a flurry of quarrels cannot be avoided.

zh: 兄弟变出官鬼，刑冲克世，不惟无财，且有口舌。
父爻更动，必讼于官。
若有救制，庶几无害。
鬼化兄，或兄鬼皆动，亦然。
朱雀临兄鬼动变，有口舌。
yi: 兄弟变出官鬼，来刑冲克世爻，不但没有财，还有口舌。
父母再发动，一定打官司。
如果有救、有制，大概就无害。
官鬼化兄弟，或兄弟、官鬼都动，也一样。
朱雀临在动变的兄弟、官鬼上，有口舌。
en: If Peer turns into Pressure and punishes, clashes or controls the Self line, not only is there no money, there are quarrels as well.
If the Resource line also moves, it will end in court.
If there is rescue or restraint, there may be no harm.
Pressure turning into Peer, or Peer and Pressure both moving, is the same.
The Vermilion Bird on a moving or changing Peer or Pressure line means quarrels.

zh: 旧注这兄弟变官鬼来克世，是有口舌纷纷，予以为谬。
大凡卦中兄弟动克世爻，化官鬼回头克制，则不能口舌耗损矣。
予之屡验者，卦中官鬼兄弟皆发动，固有口舌是非。
兄连鬼克者，此谓兄弟与官鬼也，非谓兄弟化官鬼也。
yi: 旧注说这是兄弟变出官鬼来克世，所以口舌纷纷，我认为错了。
凡是卦中兄弟动来克世爻，变出官鬼回头克它，它就不能造成口舌耗损了。
我屡次验证的是：卦中官鬼、兄弟都发动，才有口舌是非。
「兄连鬼克」说的是兄弟和官鬼（一起），不是兄弟化官鬼。
en: The old commentary takes this as Peer turning into Pressure and attacking the Self line, hence the quarrels; I think that is wrong.
Whenever a moving Peer line attacks the Self line but turns into Pressure that turns back to control it, it can no longer cause quarrels or losses.
What I have verified again and again: when Pressure and Peer both move in the hexagram, there are quarrels and trouble.
'Peer together with Pressure' means Peer and Pressure (both), not Peer turning into Pressure.

zh: 兄伤鬼克，口舌纷纷。
财持世而兄亦动者，不独劫财，还防伤已。
若更鬼动克世者，更凶。
yi: 兄弟来伤、官鬼来克，口舌纷纷。
财持世而兄弟也动，不只劫财，还要防伤到自己。
如果再有官鬼动来克世，更凶。
en: Peer harming and Pressure attacking: quarrels on every side.
If Wealth is on the Self line and Peer moves as well, it not only robs the money but may harm you.
If Pressure also moves and controls the Self line, worse still.

zh: 觉子曰：《黄金策》云：兄连鬼克，口舌难逃。
谓兄动变鬼冲克世爻者，不独无财，还防口舌。
殊不知兄动变鬼，即是兄化回头之克，自顾不暇，又焉能冲克世爻耶？
yi: 觉子说：《黄金策》说「兄连鬼克，口舌难逃」，
旧说以为是兄弟动变官鬼、来冲克世爻，不但无财，还要防口舌。
却不知道兄弟动变官鬼，就是兄弟化出回头克，自身难保，又怎么能去冲克世爻呢？
en: Juezi says: the Golden Strategy says 'Peer together with Pressure attacking: quarrels cannot be escaped';
it is taken to mean Peer moving into Pressure and clashing with or controlling the Self line: no money, and quarrels to guard against.
They do not see that Peer moving into Pressure is Peer turning into something that turns back to control it; unable to save itself, how could it clash with or control the Self line?

zh: 如：酉月丙午日(旬空：寅卯)，占贸易有利否，得“师之坎”
yi: 例：酉月丙午日（旬空寅、卯），占做买卖有没有利，得师卦变坎卦。
en: Case: You month, Bingwu day (void: Yin and Mao); the question was whether a trading venture would profit; the hexagram Shi changing to Kan.

zh: 午财持世，兄动劫之，幸水化戌土，兄爻被克，不来劫财，
许之可行，必有利息。果得利。
后于九月，其胞弟得急症而死，乃悟此卦亥水兄弟变鬼故也。
如此问财而现丧弟者，余屡见之，后学不可不留心也。
yi: 午火财持世，兄弟动来劫它，幸好亥水化出戌土，兄弟被回头克，不来劫财，
所以断可以去做，一定有利。果然得利。
后来九月，他的亲弟弟得急病死了，才明白是这一卦亥水兄弟变出官鬼的缘故。
像这样问财却应在弟弟身亡的，我见过多次，后学不能不留心。
en: The Wu Fire Wealth sat on the Self line and a moving Peer came to rob it, but luckily the Water turned into Xu Earth, so the Peer line was controlled and did not rob the money;
so I said he could go ahead and would profit. He did.
Later, in the ninth month, his younger brother died of a sudden illness, and I understood it was because the Hai Water Peer line had turned into Pressure.
I have often seen a money question show a brother's death in this way; later students must watch for it.

dispute.yi: 「兄连鬼克」怎么读：旧注读作兄弟变出官鬼来克世，主口舌、官讼；王洪绪和觉子都驳它——兄弟变官鬼是回头克，兄弟自身难保，不能再去克世；王洪绪改读为兄弟、官鬼同时发动才有口舌。野鹤把经文改成「兄伤鬼克」，并举例说兄化鬼虽然不劫财，却应在问卜人的弟弟身亡。
dispute.en: How to read 'Peer together with Pressure': the old commentary takes it as Peer turning into Pressure and attacking the Self line, meaning quarrels and lawsuits. Wang Hongxu and Juezi both reject this: Peer turning into Pressure is a turn-back control, Peer cannot save itself, let alone attack the Self line; Wang reads it instead as Peer and Pressure moving at the same time. Yehe rewrites the line as 'Peer harming, Pressure attacking', and gives a case where Peer turning into Pressure did not rob the money but showed up as the death of the asker's younger brother.

rule.yi: 父化财：辛劳后得。兄化财：先散后聚（后利前不利）。官化财：利公门、谒贵、九流手艺求财；私财先惊后喜、先阻后得；若官鬼克世，为「助鬼伤身」，不吉（王洪绪）。
rule.en: Resource turning into Wealth: gain after toil. Peer turning into Wealth: first scattered, then gathered (good later, not at first). Pressure turning into Wealth: favours official money, patrons and people who live by a trade; for private money, fright then joy, obstruction then gain; if Pressure controls the Self line it is 'feeding the ghost that harms you', unlucky (Wang Hongxu).

zh: 父化财，
必辛勤而有得；
yi: 父母化出妻财，
一定要辛勤才有所得；
en: Resource turning into Wealth:
gain comes only through hard work;

zh: 父化财，不自然而得，必勤劳后得。
兄化财，先散后聚；或利于后，不利于前。
官化财，最利公门谒贵，及九流艺术之人，求财十分有望。
私财，则先惊后喜，或先阻后得。
yi: 父母化财，财不会自然到手，一定要勤劳之后才得。
兄弟化财，先散后聚；或者后面有利，前面不利。
官鬼化财，最利于在官府、拜见权贵求财，以及九流、手艺之人，求财很有希望。
如果是私人的财，就先惊后喜，或先有阻碍后得到。
en: Resource turning into Wealth: the money does not come of itself; it comes after hard work.
Peer turning into Wealth: first scattered, then gathered; or favourable later, not at first.
Pressure turning into Wealth is best for money sought in official quarters or from patrons, and for people who live by a trade or an art; the money is very likely.
For private money, first a fright and then joy, or first obstruction and then gain.

zh: 父化财不能自然而得，必勤劳可有。
兄化财先散后聚，或利于后不利于前。
官化财爻生合世身，最利公门谒贵及九流艺术之人，求财十分有望；
如官来克世，谓之助鬼伤身，公私皆不吉也。
yi: 父母化财，不能自然得到，一定要勤劳才有。
兄弟化财先散后聚，或者后面有利前面不利。
官鬼化出财爻、生合世爻卦身，最利于官府、拜见权贵以及九流手艺之人，求财很有希望；
如果官鬼来克世，叫作「助鬼伤身」（财去生鬼，鬼来伤自己），公事私事都不吉。
en: Resource turning into Wealth cannot come of itself; only hard work brings it.
Peer turning into Wealth: first scattered, then gathered, or favourable later but not at first.

Pressure turning into a Wealth line that generates or combines with the Self and Body lines is best for official quarters and patrons and for people who live by a trade or an art: the money is very likely;
if the Pressure line controls the Self line, it is called 'feeding the ghost that harms you' (the money feeds Pressure, and Pressure hurts you): public or private, it is unlucky.

rule.yi: 财化官鬼最凶：损折虚耗、有惊险，伤世则因财致祸。财化兄弟：与人分利、先聚后散（王洪绪把它和财化鬼并列为最凶）。财化父母：得后艰辛或只一次。财化死墓空绝：有名无实；若生合世爻，宜抢先去取。
rule.en: Wealth turning into Pressure is the worst: losses, waste and danger, and disaster brought on by the money if it harms the Self line. Wealth turning into Peer: sharing the profit, gathered then scattered (Wang Hongxu ranks it with Wealth-into-Pressure as the worst). Wealth turning into Resource: hardship after the gain, or only once. Wealth turning into death, tomb, void or extinction: a name without substance; if it generates or combines with the Self line, act at once.

zh: 财化鬼，
防耗折而惊忧。
yi: 妻财化出官鬼，
要防耗损折本，还有惊忧。
en: Wealth turning into Pressure:
beware of losses, and of fright and worry.

zh: 财化官最凶。主损折虚耗，自有惊险。
更伤世爻，切恐因财致祸。
财化兄，主与人分利；或先聚后散；或利于前，不利于后。
财化父，主得后艰辛；或只许一度。
财化死墓空绝，是有虚名，无实利之象。
若得生合世爻，则上前有功，稍迟则无也。
yi: 财化官鬼最凶，主亏损虚耗，还有惊险。
如果再伤世爻，就怕因财惹祸。
财化兄弟，主和别人分利；或先聚后散；或前面有利、后面不利。
财化父母，主得财以后很辛苦；或者只有一次。
财化入死、墓、空、绝，是有虚名、无实利之象。
如果变出的爻生合世爻，就是抢先去做有收获，稍晚就没了。
en: Wealth turning into Pressure is the worst: losses and waste, and danger besides.
If it also harms the Self line, beware of disaster brought on by the money.
Wealth turning into Peer: sharing the profit with others; or first gathered, then scattered; or favourable at first, not later.
Wealth turning into Resource: hardship after the gain; or it happens only once.
Wealth turning into death, tomb, void or extinction: a name without real profit.
If the changed line generates or combines with the Self line, going at once pays; a little later there is nothing.

zh: 财化官鬼 或化兄最凶，主损折驳耗，
更见世爻有伤，恐因财致祸。
yi: 财化官鬼或化兄弟最凶，主亏损、折耗，
再见世爻受伤，恐怕因财惹祸。
en: Wealth turning into Pressure or into Peer is the worst: losses and waste;
if the Self line is harmed as well, beware of disaster brought on by the money.

dispute.yi: 财化兄弟有多凶：旧注说是与人分利、先聚后散；王洪绪把它和财化官鬼并列为「最凶」。
dispute.en: How bad is Wealth turning into Peer? The old commentary: sharing the profit, gathered then scattered. Wang Hongxu puts it alongside Wealth turning into Pressure as 'the worst'.

units.title: 财局合福神，万倍利源可取

rule.yi: 三合成财局而子孙在局中动，或成子孙局而财在局中动，并来生合世爻：财利不绝，财旺可许厚利（经文说万倍，野鹤说百倍）；野鹤要世爻在局中或局来生世。合成父局辛劳、兄局破耗、鬼局阻隔口舌，克世更凶。
rule.en: A three-harmony Wealth frame with Output moving inside it, or an Output frame with Wealth moving inside it, generating or combining with the Self line: profit without end, and with a strong Wealth a great profit (the classic says ten-thousandfold, Yehe a hundredfold); Yehe requires the Self line to be in the frame or to be generated by it. A Resource frame means toil, a Peer frame losses, a Pressure frame obstruction and quarrels, worse if it controls the Self line.

zh: 财局合福神，
万倍利源可取；
yi: 财局合着子孙，
万倍的利源可以取得；
en: A Wealth frame that includes Output:
profit ten-thousandfold is there to take;

zh: 卦有三合，会成财局，而子孙亦在合中动者，上吉之卦。
主财利绵绵不竭。更得财旺，可许万倍财利。
会成福局，而财爻又在合中，动来生合世爻者，亦然。
若会鬼局，则多阻隔。会成兄局，则主分散。会成父局，艰辛难得。
yi: 卦里有三合，会成财局，而子孙也在合局中发动，是上吉之卦。
主财利绵绵不绝。再加上财旺，可以断万倍之利。
会成子孙局，而财爻也在局中、动来生合世爻，也一样。
如果会成官鬼局，多阻隔；会成兄弟局，主分散；会成父母局，艰辛难得。
en: If three lines combine into a three-harmony frame of the Wealth element and Output moves within it, it is a first-class hexagram.
The profit never runs dry; if Wealth is also strong, a ten-thousandfold profit may be granted.
The same if the frame is of the Output element and the Wealth line is in it, moving to generate or combine with the Self line.
A Pressure frame means much obstruction; a Peer frame means dispersal; a Resource frame means hardship and little gain.

zh: 卦有三合会成财局，而在卦中动来生世，主财利绵绵不竭，
更得财旺，可许万倍财利。
会成福局动来生合世爻者亦然。
yi: 卦里三合会成财局，并且在卦中动来生世爻，主财利绵绵不绝；
再加上财旺，可以断万倍之利。
会成子孙局、动来生合世爻，也一样。
en: If three lines form a three-harmony Wealth frame that moves to generate the Self line, the profit never runs dry;
if Wealth is also strong, a ten-thousandfold profit may be granted.
The same for an Output frame that moves to generate or combine with the Self line.

zh: 财局合福德，百倍利源可许。
世与财爻，或与子孙爻三合成局，诸占物阜财丰。
野鹤曰：须要在局中，或是合成财局、子孙局生世，方为全美。
倘合成父局，辛苦劳碌；合成兄局，破耗多端；合成鬼局，灾非口舌；克世者更凶。
yi: 财局合着子孙，可以断百倍之利。
世爻和财爻，或和子孙爻三合成局，占什么都物产丰盛、财源充足。
野鹤说：世爻要在合局之中，或者合成的财局、子孙局来生世，才算完美。
如果合成父母局，辛苦劳碌；合成兄弟局，破耗很多；合成官鬼局，灾祸是非口舌；局来克世更凶。
en: A Wealth frame joined with Output: a hundredfold profit may be granted.
When the Self line forms a three-harmony frame with the Wealth line or with the Output line, every question shows goods and money in plenty.
Yehe says: the Self line must be inside the frame, or a Wealth or Output frame must generate it; only then is it perfect.
A Resource frame means toil; a Peer frame, losses of every kind; a Pressure frame, trouble and quarrels; worse still if the frame controls the Self line.

units.title: 岁君逢劫杀，一年生意无聊

rule.yi: 占长期买卖看太岁：太岁临兄弟（劫杀），一年无利，兄弟上卦发动必有损耗；临官鬼一年惊忧，临父母一年艰辛，临财福一年顺利。
rule.en: For long-term trade, look at the Tai Sui: on Peer (the robber), no profit all year, and losses if that Peer line shows and moves; on Pressure, a year of worry; on Resource, a year of hardship; on Wealth or Output, a smooth year.

zh: 岁君逢劫杀，
一年生意无聊。
yi: 太岁落在兄弟（劫杀）上，
这一年生意都没意思。
en: If the Tai Sui falls on the robber (Peer),
the whole year's business is dull.

zh: 凡占久远买卖，最怕太岁临持兄弟，主一年无利。
出现变动，必然损耗。
岁持官鬼，一年惊忧。持父一年艰辛。
岁持财福，生意滔滔，一年顺利也。
yi: 凡是占长期的买卖，最怕太岁临兄弟，主一年没有利。
（这个兄弟）出现在卦上又发动，一定有损耗。
太岁临官鬼，一年惊忧；临父母，一年艰辛。
太岁临妻财、子孙，生意兴隆，一年顺利。
en: In any question about long-term trade, the thing most feared is the Tai Sui falling on Peer: no profit for the year.
If that line appears in the hexagram and moves, there will certainly be losses.
The Tai Sui on Pressure: a year of fright and worry. On Resource: a year of hardship.
On Wealth or Output: business flows and the year goes smoothly.

zh: 凡占久远买卖，最怕太岁临持兄弟，主一年无利。
持官鬼一年惊忧，持父一年艰辛，财福一年顺利也。
yi: 凡是占长期的买卖，最怕太岁临兄弟，主一年没有利。
临官鬼一年惊忧，临父母一年艰辛，临财福一年顺利。
en: In any question about long-term trade, the thing most feared is the Tai Sui falling on Peer: no profit for the year.
On Pressure, a year of worry; on Resource, a year of hardship; on Wealth or Output, a smooth year.

zh: 岁君逢劫煞，一年生意无聊。
劫煞者，乃兄弟之爻也，兄临太岁，一年破耗。
yi: 太岁逢劫煞，一年生意没意思。
劫煞就是兄弟爻；兄弟临太岁，一年破耗。
en: If the Tai Sui meets the robber, the whole year's business is dull.
The robber here is the Peer line; Peer on the Tai Sui means a year of losses.

note.yi: 这里的「劫杀」「劫煞」指兄弟爻（野鹤明说）。《天玄赋》求财章的「劫杀加临兄位」里，劫杀是另一个神煞，不是兄弟，不要混。
note.en: Here 'the robber' (jiesha) means the Peer line, as Yehe says outright. In the Tianxuan Fu's chapter on wealth, 'the robber star on the Peer line' names a separate spirit-star, not Peer; do not confuse the two.

units.title: 世应二爻空合，虚约难凭

rule.yi: 世爻空：有财难得；应爻空：别人靠不住；世应俱空：谋事无准。空而动又相合（或化空），为「虚约」，口头答应而不实。
rule.en: Self line void: even existing money is hard to get. Other line void: others cannot be relied on. Both void: nothing certain. Void and moving yet combining (or turning void) is an 'empty promise': agreed in words, not in fact.

zh: 世应二爻空合，
虚约难凭；
yi: 世、应两爻落空又相合，
是空口的约定，靠不住；
en: If the Self and Other lines are void yet combining,
it is an empty promise that cannot be relied on;

zh: 世空，有财难得；应空，难靠他人；
世应俱空，艰辛无准实。
空动带合，谓之虚约。
化入空亡，亦是心口不相应之象。
yi: 世爻空，有财也难得；应爻空，靠不住别人；
世、应都空，辛苦而没有准头。
空而发动、又带相合，叫作「虚约」。
动而化入空亡，也是心口不一之象。
en: Self void: even existing money is hard to get; Other void: others cannot be relied on;
both void: toil with nothing certain.
Void and moving yet combining: that is called an empty promise.
Turning into the void is also a sign that words and intentions do not match.

zh: 世空有财难得，应空难靠他人，
世应俱空谋无准实，空动带合谓之虚约，化空亦然。
yi: 世空有财也难得，应空靠不住别人，
世应都空，谋事没有准头；空而动又带合，叫作虚约；化空也一样。
en: Self void: money hard to get; Other void: others unreliable;
both void: nothing certain in the plan; void, moving and combining is called an empty promise; turning void is the same.

units.title: 主人一位刑伤，往求不遇

rule.yi: 去求某人得财，以代表他的那一爻为「主人」（求贵人看官鬼，求妇人看妻财，不知是谁看应爻）。这一爻被日辰、动爻刑克，或空、化空：见不到，见了也无益；生合世爻、化出财爻生合世爻：最吉。
rule.en: When the money depends on someone you go to, the line standing for that person is the 'patron' (Pressure for a person of rank, Wealth for a woman, the Other line if you cannot tell). If that line is punished or controlled by the Day or a moving line, or is void or turns void, you will not find them and meeting would not help; if it generates or combines with the Self line, or turns into Wealth that does, it is best.

zh: 主人一位刑伤，
往求不遇。
yi: 所求之人那一爻受刑伤，
去求也见不到。
en: If the line of the person you go to is punished or harmed,
you will not find them when you go.

zh: 主人：如求贵人，财鬼为主；求妇人财，财为主类。
若主人遇动爻日辰刑克，或自空化空，皆主不遇，遇亦不利。
须得生合世爻，财为契爱，求必易得。
主人化出财爻，生合世爻，最吉。
不知主人，以应爻论之。
yi: 主人（所求的人）：比如求贵人，以财、官鬼为主；求妇女的财，以财为主，诸如此类。
如果主人那一爻被动爻、日辰刑克，或自身落空、化空，都主见不到，见到也不利。
要它生合世爻，财来得情愿，求财一定容易。
主人那一爻化出财爻、生合世爻，最吉。
不知道主人该看哪一爻，就用应爻来论。
en: The patron (the person you go to): when seeking a person of rank, Wealth and Pressure stand for them; when seeking money from a woman, Wealth does, and so on.
If that line is punished or controlled by a moving line or the Day, or is void or turns void, you will not find them, and meeting them would not help.
It should generate or combine with the Self line; then the money is given willingly and is easy to get.
If that line turns into a Wealth line that generates or combines with the Self line, it is best.
If you cannot tell which line is the patron, judge by the Other line.

zh: 主人，如求贵人则鬼为主，求妇人财为主类。
若主爻遇日辰动爻刑伤，或自空、或化空，皆主不遇，遇亦不利。
yi: 主人：比如求贵人，就以官鬼为主；求妇女，就以财为主，诸如此类。
如果主人那一爻被日辰、动爻刑伤，或者自身落空、化空，都主见不到，见到也不利。
en: The patron: when seeking a person of rank, Pressure stands for them; when seeking a woman, Wealth, and so on.
If that line is punished or harmed by the Day or a moving line, or is void or turns void, you will not find them, and meeting would not help.

note.yi: 求贵人时，旧注写「财鬼为主」，王洪绪写「鬼为主」；王的写法和「求妇人财为主」一句对得更齐，但两个本子各自如此，不改原文。
note.en: For a person of rank the old commentary says 'Wealth and Pressure stand for them', Wang Hongxu says 'Pressure'. Wang's wording pairs more neatly with 'Wealth for a woman', but each edition reads as it does and we leave both as they are.

units.title: 世持空鬼，多因自己迟疑

rule.yi: 官鬼持世，财来生鬼，本来求财容易；若世上的官鬼（或妻财）落空，是自己迟疑退缩，所以不成。
rule.en: With Pressure on the Self line, Wealth feeds it and money should come easily; if that Pressure (or a Wealth) on the Self line is void, it is your own hesitation that makes it fail.

zh: 世持空鬼，
多因自己迟疑；
yi: 世爻持官鬼而落空，
多半是因为自己迟疑；
en: If the Self line holds a void Pressure line,
it is mostly because you yourself hesitate;

zh: 鬼爻持世，财必相生，凡求必易。
若遇空亡，乃是自不上前，迟疑退懒，故无成也。
世持空财亦然。
yi: 官鬼持世，财一定来生它，凡是求财一定容易。
如果逢空亡，是自己不上前，迟疑退缩、懒散，所以不成。
世爻持财而落空，也一样。
en: With the Pressure line on the Self line, Wealth is bound to feed it, and anything sought comes easily.
If it is void, it is you who hold back, hesitating and slacking, so nothing comes of it.
A void Wealth on the Self line is the same.

zh: 鬼爻持世，财必相生，凡求必易；
若遇空亡，乃自不上前，迟疑退怯，故无成也。
世持空财亦然。
yi: 官鬼持世，财一定来生它，凡是求财一定容易；
如果逢空亡，是自己不上前，迟疑胆怯，所以不成。
世爻持财而落空，也一样。
en: With the Pressure line on the Self line, Wealth feeds it and anything sought comes easily;
if it is void, it is you who hold back, hesitant and timid, so nothing comes of it.
A void Wealth on the Self line is the same.

units.title: 辰合动财，却被他人把住

rule.yi: 财爻动来生合世爻本易得；若被日辰或动爻合住，财被人把持：合它的那一爻（卦无财则看财伏在哪一爻下）就是把持的人，如父母为长辈、官鬼为贵人；到冲开之日才到手（王洪绪）。
rule.en: A moving Wealth line that generates or combines with the Self line is easy money; but if the Day or a moving line combines with and holds it, someone is keeping it back. The holding line (or, if there is no Wealth, the line the hidden Wealth lies under) shows who: Resource an elder, Pressure a person of rank. It arrives on the day that clashes the combination open (Wang Hongxu).

zh: 辰合动财，
却被他人把住。
yi: 日辰合住发动的财爻，
这财就被别人把持住了。
en: When the Day combines with a moving Wealth line,
someone else has hold of the money.

zh: 要财动来生合，固是易得之兆；
若被动爻日辰合住，其财必有人把持主张，不能与我也。
要知何人把持，以合爻定之。如父母合住，为尊长把持类。
卦若无财，看伏何爻下，亦可推之。如伏官下，为贵人把持之类。
yi: 财爻动来生合世爻，本来是容易得的征兆；
如果被动爻或日辰合住，这财一定有人把持、做主，不能给我。
要知道是谁把持，看合住它的那一爻：比如父母合住，就是长辈把持，诸如此类。
卦里如果没有财，看财伏在哪一爻下面，也能推出来：比如伏在官鬼下，就是贵人把持，诸如此类。
en: Wealth moving to generate or combine with you is certainly a sign of easy gain;
but if a moving line or the Day combines with it and holds it, someone is controlling the money and it cannot come to me.
To know who holds it, look at the combining line: if Resource holds it, an elder is in control, and so on.
If the hexagram has no Wealth, see which line the hidden Wealth lies under: under Pressure, a person of rank is holding it, and so on.

zh: 财爻动来生合世，固是易得之象，
若被动爻日辰合住，其财必有人把住，不能与我。
要知何人把持，以合爻定之，如父母合住为尊长把持类。
要知何日到手，必待逢冲之日方有也。
yi: 财爻动来生合世爻，本来是容易得的象；
如果被动爻、日辰合住，这财一定有人把住，不能给我。
要知道是谁把持，看合住它的那一爻，比如父母合住，就是长辈把持，诸如此类。
要知道哪天到手，一定要等到冲开合的那一天。
en: The Wealth line moving to generate or combine with the Self line is certainly a sign of easy gain;
if a moving line or the Day combines with and holds it, someone has hold of the money and it cannot come to me.
To know who holds it, look at the combining line: Resource holding it means an elder, and so on.
As for when it arrives: only on a day that clashes the combination open.

units.title: 要知何日得财，不离旺衰生合

rule.yi: 定得财之日看财爻状态：有气→合日或本日；太旺、太过→墓库日；休囚、逢绝→生旺日；被合、入墓→冲开之日；逢冲→合日；动逢月破→填实或合日；静→冲日；旬空→出旬；伏藏→出现（提起）之日。财死绝而有子孙扶，按子孙断；卦无财而兄弟生子孙，按兄弟断。
rule.en: Time the money by the state of the Wealth line: with force, the day that combines with it or its own day; over-strong or in excess, its tomb day; resting, trapped or extinguished, a day that births or empowers it; combined or entombed, the day that clashes it open; clashed, the combining day; moving under a Month-break, the day that fills it in or combines with it; still, the clashing day; void, once the cycle passes; hidden, the day it appears. If Wealth is dead but propped up by Output, time it by Output; if there is no Wealth and Peer feeds Output, time it by Peer.

zh: 要知何日得财，
不离旺衰生合；
yi: 要知道哪天得财，
离不开旺、衰、生、合；
en: To know on what day the money comes,
go by strength, weakness, generation and combination;

zh: 财爻有气，合日得财；或本日得财。
太旺，墓库日得；
休囚，生旺日得；
太过，收藏日得；
合住入墓，破合破墓日得；
旺空，过旬日得；
伏藏，提起日得。
财爻死绝，而得子孙动来扶起，即以子孙爻断。
卦无财爻，而得兄弟生扶子孙财源者，即以兄弟爻断。更宜通变。
yi: 财爻有气，在合它的日子得；或者在它本身值日的那天得。
太旺的，在它入墓库的日子得；
休囚的，在生它、旺它的日子得；
太多的，在收藏（入墓）的日子得；
被合住或入墓的，在冲破合、冲开墓的日子得；
旺而落空的，过了这一旬得；
伏藏的，在它被提起（出现）的日子得。
财爻死绝，而有子孙动来扶起它，就用子孙爻来断日子。
卦里没有财爻，而有兄弟去生扶子孙这个财源，就用兄弟爻来断日子。还要灵活变通。
en: A Wealth line with force: the money comes on the day that combines with it, or on the day of its own branch.
Over-strong: on the day of its tomb;
resting or trapped: on a day that births or empowers it;
in excess: on the day it is stored away (its tomb);
held by a combination or in its tomb: on the day that breaks the combination or opens the tomb;
strong but void: once the ten-day cycle has passed;
hidden: on the day it is lifted into view.
If the Wealth line is dead or extinguished but a moving Output line props it up, time it by the Output line.
If the hexagram has no Wealth line but a Peer line feeds Output, the source of money, time it by the Peer line. Judge flexibly.

zh: 财动入墓或被合，皆待冲日得；
或动财遇绝，必待生日得；
逢冲合日得；
动逢月破，填实逢合日得；
或安静，逢冲日得；
旬空出旬得；伏藏出现日得。
yi: 财爻动而入墓或被合住，都等冲的日子得；
发动的财爻逢绝，一定等生它的日子得；
逢冲的，在合它的日子得；
动而逢月破，等填实（本支值日）或逢合的日子得；
安静的，逢冲的日子得；
旬空的出了旬得；伏藏的在出现的日子得。
en: Wealth moving into its tomb, or held by a combination: wait for the clashing day;
a moving Wealth meeting extinction: wait for the day that gives it birth;
one that is clashed: on the day that combines with it;
moving but under a Month-break: on the day that fills it in or combines with it;
still: on the clashing day;
void: once out of the void cycle; hidden: on the day it appears.

units.title: 欲决何时有利，但详春夏秋冬

rule.yi: 货物何时得价：旧注按财爻五行当令的季节（木春、土夏而六月更好，同类中取更旺之月）；王洪绪说不能一概按五行，还要用冲合、生绝、墓开之法并看子孙爻。两家都说：财坐日辰的长生，一天比一天贵；坐帝旺，眼下正好，迟则贱。
rule.en: When goods will fetch a price: the old commentary goes by the season of the Wealth line's element (Wood in spring, Earth in summer and best in the sixth month, choosing the stronger month within a season); Wang Hongxu says not to rely on the element alone but also on clash and combination, birth and extinction, the opening of tombs, and the Output line. Both agree: Wealth at its Birth stage under the Day gains value day by day; at its Peak, now is the time, and later it cheapens.

zh: 欲决何时有利，
但详春夏秋冬。
yi: 要断定什么时候有利，
只要细看春夏秋冬（四时的旺衰）。
en: To decide when there will be profit,
look closely at spring, summer, autumn and winter.

zh: 凡占货物何时得价，以财临五行断之。
如木财，春月得价，一阳后亦好。
土财，夏月有利，六月更美。余仿此。
又如财临辰土，二月不如三月；财临酉金，七月不如八月。余亦仿此。
又如财主日下长生之地，此货一日得价一日；
若坐帝旺，眼下正及时，稍迟则贱而无利。
yi: 凡是占货物什么时候卖得上价，看财爻的五行来断。
比如财属木，春天的月份得价，冬至（一阳生）以后也好。
财属土，夏天的月份有利，六月更好。其余照此类推。
又比如财是辰土，二月不如三月；财是酉金，七月不如八月。其余也照此类推。
再比如财爻处在日辰的长生之地，这货一天比一天值钱；
如果坐帝旺，眼下正是时候，稍晚就便宜了、没有利。
en: In asking when goods will fetch a good price, judge by the element of the Wealth line.
Wood Wealth, for instance, sells well in the spring months, and is good after the winter solstice too (when the first yang returns).
Earth Wealth profits in the summer months, best in the sixth month. The rest by analogy.
Again, Wealth on Chen Earth: the second month is not as good as the third; Wealth on You Metal: the seventh month is not as good as the eighth. The rest by analogy.
Again, if the Wealth line sits at its Birth stage under the Day, the goods gain value day by day;
if it sits at its Peak, now is exactly the time; a little later the price drops and there is no profit.

zh: 凡占货物何时得价，不可概以财临五行断之，如木财断春冬得价。
又宜以冲待合、合待冲、绝逢生、墓待开等法，又宜以子孙爻断。
又如财坐长生之地，一日得一日价，
若从帝旺，目下正及时，迟则贱而无利。
yi: 凡是占货物什么时候得价，不能一概按财爻的五行来断，比如木财就断春、冬得价。
还要用「冲等合、合等冲、绝逢生、墓等开」这些方法，也要看子孙爻来断。
又比如财爻坐长生之地，一天比一天值钱；
如果在帝旺，眼下正当时，晚了就便宜、没有利。
en: In asking when goods will fetch a price, do not simply go by the element of the Wealth line, as in judging that Wood Wealth sells in spring and winter.
Use also the methods of a clashed line waiting for its combination, a combined line waiting for its clash, extinction meeting birth, and a tomb waiting to be opened; judge by the Output line as well.
Again, Wealth at its Birth stage gains value day by day;
at its Peak, now is the time; later the price drops and there is no profit.

dispute.yi: 旧注主张按财爻五行的当令季节断得价之时；王洪绪说不能一概而论，还要用冲合、生绝、墓开的方法，并看子孙爻。
dispute.en: The old commentary times the price by the season of the Wealth line's element; Wang Hongxu says that is too simple and adds clash-and-combination, birth-and-extinction, tomb-opening and the Output line.

rule.yi: 合伙：世、应都是财爻最好；兄弟安静（或临卦身而世爻静）不嫌，因为合伙本要分财；兄弟发动则不宜。世应两动或落空：合不长久；相冲克：日后不和；化出兄官：多私心；世应生合而被刑冲克害：有人挑拨。野鹤：世、应临兄弟仍不吉，只有日月为财冲克世时反吉。
rule.en: Partnership: best if both the Self and Other lines are Wealth; a still Peer (or Peer on the Body line with the Self line still) is no objection, since partners share the money anyway; a moving Peer is bad. Self and Other both moving or void: it will not last; clashing or controlling each other: they will fall out; turning into Peer or Pressure: self-interest; combining but punished, clashed or controlled by others: someone will sow discord. Yehe: Peer on the Self or Other line is still unlucky, except when the Day or Month is Wealth and clashes with or controls the Self line.

zh: 合伙不嫌兄弟；
yi: 合伙做生意，不嫌有兄弟；
en: In a partnership, Peer is no objection;

zh: 凡占合伙买卖，若世应俱财爻，必然称意。
兄临卦身，世爻安静不妨。
盖合必至分财，故也。
动则不宜。
世应两动，必合不久，空亡亦然。
相冲相克，后必不睦。
化出兄官，必多私心。
世应生合，而被动爻日辰刑冲克害者，必有挑唆破说也。
yi: 凡是占合伙买卖，如果世、应都是财爻，一定如意。
兄弟临卦身，只要世爻安静，也不要紧。
因为合伙本来就一定要分财。
（兄弟）发动就不好。
世、应都动，合伙一定不长久；（世应）落空亡也一样。
世应相冲相克，日后一定不和。
（世应）化出兄弟、官鬼，一定多私心。
世应相生相合，却被动爻或日辰刑冲克害，一定有人挑拨离间。
en: In a partnership question, if both the Self and the Other lines are Wealth lines, it will go as wished.
Peer on the Body line does no harm as long as the Self line is still.
For a partnership means sharing the money anyway.
But a moving Peer is not good.
If the Self and Other lines both move, the partnership will not last; the same if they are void.
If they clash or control each other, the partners will fall out later.
If they turn into Peer or Pressure, there will be much self-interest.
If Self and Other generate or combine with each other but a moving line or the Day punishes, clashes, controls or harms them, someone will sow discord between them.

zh: 凡占合伙买卖，若世应俱财必然称意。
兄临卦身必主分财故也。
静者无嫌，动则不宜。
yi: 凡占合伙买卖，世、应都是财，一定如意。
兄弟临卦身，本来就主分财，所以不嫌。
兄弟安静不嫌，发动就不好。
en: In a partnership question, Wealth on both Self and Other means it goes as wished.
Peer on the Body line simply means sharing the money, which is why it is no objection.
Still, it is no objection; moving, it is not good.

zh: 合伙不嫌兄弟，乏本内外无财。
世应临兄不吉，兄爻发动亦不吉。
倘世临兄弟，日月作财星冲克世者，反为吉也。
yi: 合伙不嫌有兄弟；缺本钱的，卦里内外都没有财。
世、应临兄弟不吉，兄弟发动也不吉。
如果世爻临兄弟，而日辰月建是财、来冲克世爻，反而是吉。
en: A partnership does not mind Peer; lacking capital shows as no Wealth inside or out.
Yet Peer on the Self or Other line is unlucky, and so is a moving Peer line.
But if the Self line carries Peer and the Day or Month is Wealth and clashes with or controls the Self line, it becomes lucky after all.

dispute.yi: 兄弟到底嫌不嫌：经文说合伙不嫌兄弟；旧注、王洪绪说兄弟静可以、动不宜；野鹤引了经文，却接着说世、应临兄弟不吉、兄弟动也不吉，只有日月为财冲克世爻时反吉。
dispute.en: Is Peer really no objection? The classic says so for partnerships; the old commentary and Wang Hongxu allow a still Peer but not a moving one; Yehe quotes the classic but then says Peer on the Self or Other line is unlucky and a moving Peer too, the only exception being a Wealth Day or Month clashing with or controlling the Self line.

rule.yi: 一般占财忌官鬼发动（阻隔）；求公门（官府）之财反要官鬼：无鬼或鬼空，财旺也难到手；官鬼旺相、生合世爻卦身则吉；刑克世爻主责罚、祸害立至；官鬼死绝也不济事，须财、官两全才大吉。
rule.en: Money questions usually fear a moving Pressure line (obstruction), but money from official quarters needs Pressure: with no Pressure line, or a void one, even a strong Wealth is hard to get; Pressure thriving and generating or combining with the Self and Body lines is good; Pressure punishing or controlling the Self line means punishment and immediate trouble; a dead or extinguished Pressure line is no use either; only with both Wealth and Pressure sound is it very good.

zh: 公门何虑官爻。
yi: 在官府求财，何必顾虑官鬼。
en: For money from official quarters, why worry about the Pressure line?

zh: 占财皆忌官动，主有阻隔。
惟求公门之财，必然倚托官府。
若无鬼爻，或落空亡，则虽财爻有气，亦难到手。
必得旺相，生合世身则吉。
刑克世爻，主有杖责。
死绝亦不济事，须得财鬼两全，方为大吉。
yi: 占财一般都忌官鬼发动，主有阻隔。
只有求官府的财，一定要依靠官府。
如果没有官鬼，或官鬼落空亡，那么财爻即使有气，也难到手。
官鬼一定要旺相、生合世爻卦身才吉。
官鬼刑克世爻，主受杖刑责罚。
官鬼死绝也不管用，要财、官两全，才是大吉。
en: Money questions generally fear a moving Pressure line: it means obstruction.
Only money from official quarters depends on the officials.
If there is no Pressure line, or it is void, then even a Wealth line with force is hard to get into hand.
The Pressure line must be thriving and must generate or combine with the Self and Body lines; then it is good.
If it punishes or controls the Self line, expect a beating or punishment.
A dead or extinguished Pressure line is no use either; only with both Wealth and Pressure sound is it very good.

zh: 占财皆忌官动，主有阻隔，
唯求公门之财，必然倚托官府，
必得旺相生合世身则吉，刑克世爻祸害立至。
yi: 占财一般忌官鬼动，主阻隔；
只有求官府的财，一定要依靠官府，
官鬼要旺相、生合世爻卦身才吉，刑克世爻，祸害马上就来。
en: Money questions generally fear a moving Pressure line, which means obstruction;
only money from official quarters depends on the officials,
so the Pressure line must be thriving and generate or combine with the Self and Body lines; if it punishes or controls the Self line, disaster comes at once.
